name: PowerShell
summary: Adversaries may abuse PowerShell commands and scripts for execution. PowerShell is a powerful interactive command-line interface and scripting environment included in the Windows operating system. Adversaries can use PowerShell to perform a number of actions, including discovery of information and execution of code. Examples include the Start-Process cmdlet which can be used to run an executable and the Invoke-Command cmdlet which runs a command…

strategies.name: Behavioral Detection of PowerShell Execution in ICS

analytics.name: Analytic 2086
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies direct PowerShell execution or indirect System.Management.Automation use with an unexpected parent, encoded/obfuscated arguments, unusual module loading, or execution followed by OT-relevant network/process activity. Alert only when the interpreter is not part of the asset's approved software/automation baseline or its execution context violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/user rule, and require OT-relevant corroboration such as access to engineering files, ICS software/API use, communications with protected OT assets, configuration change, or another suspicious follow-on behavior.
